entries.notes: Premium pass 2 (2026-11-10, SV-01, after review): smooth stylised forms instead of box primitives. Superellipse-lofted torso, bulged 12-sided limbs with ball joints, and every armour plate is a curved shell sampled from the body surface it sits on (chest, side, back, abdomen bands, pauldrons in two layers, bracers, thigh, knee, shin and toe guards) with a chamfered rim, so the suit reads as layered panels. Soft cloth hood (deep opening, soft brow point, loose folds, rolled rim) over a glossy black visor with cyan slits; cowl and V scarf; cross straps over the plates; belt pouches. Suit panel seams and cloth creases are baked into the normal map (bake-time bump). A shorter flowing cloth cape (12 x 10 grid, folds and a pointed hem, flaring back) is skinned to cape_rig (Skeleton3D on import, bones cape_root and a 3 x 3 grid cape_<column>_<row>) parented under torso, with sway keyed in every clip. Everything else is a rigid node rig, unchanged: hips > torso > head > hood, torso > arm_weapon > forearm_weapon > weapon_socket, torso > arm_support > forearm_support, hips > leg_r/leg_l > shin_r/shin_l. arm_weapon pivots at the right (camera-side) shoulder; rotation 0 aims along +X and the aim angle is a rotation about +Z, as in OperativeRig. Mount the weapon glb on weapon_socket with no offset (weapon origin = grip). The support arm is separate; copy a share of the arm_weapon rotation to arm_support if the far hand should follow the aim. Head carries the emissive visor slits (in the baked emission mask). Animations are node TRS clips at 30 fps, in place, every node keyed in every clip so clips can be switched cleanly. Material: one baked 1024 set embedded in the glb (chr_operative_a: albedo, tangent normal, ORM, emission mask; library surfaces from the surfaces stream baked through a unique UV), no COLOR_0. Per v1.9 keep emission enabled. Quality: stylised production candidate built procedurally; it reads well at game distance but is not a sculpted hero character (procedural shells, no cloth simulation, 5892 of 6,000 tris). Form language follows the project concept frames SV-01 to SV-07 (see their manifest entries); no concept pixels are used in the mesh. glb 4083 KB.
